release_notes: Export now shows a permanent Generate + Autopilot action as the recommended quiz-release workflow instead of relying on runtime button injection.
The Export page is simplified around Autopilot, with the detailed voice, branding, effects, music and manual render controls moved into a collapsible Settings & manual render options section.
Legacy injected Generate + Schedule / Generate + Autopilot controls are hidden so there is one obvious automation button.

Autopilot continues to generate fresh quizzes, schedule full YouTube videos on the next free days, create promo Shorts, tracking links and website releases, and prepare YouTube/Facebook promo scheduling.
Factburst tracking continues to use the branded https://go.factburstquiz.com domain.
